arguments.question: For NVDA, MU and QQQ over the next 63 trading sessions, analyze the registered daily price series and relevant benchmarks (QQQ, XLK, SPY). Report dated price-trend, relative-performance, drawdown/volatility and technically defined review levels only where series support them. Distinguish observed series facts from technical inferences; identify what price behavior would change each relative assessment. Stop after computing a compact, reproducible set of trend and relative-return measures from the supplied series; do not assert live intraday levels.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether market trend, relative performance, and downside behavior support or counter a company-fundamental differentiation versus QQQ during the stated horizon.
